dataset.title: Degradation path indicators for lithium-ion batteries

chronology.development_cell_rule: F0001 is permanently excluded from all confirmation estimates, intervals, gates, figures, and success fractions

schema_and_target.time_conversion: multiply numeric hours by 3600 to obtain seconds
schema_and_target.cycle_discharge_capacity_rule: within each cycle, sum max(Ah[j-1]-Ah[j],0) over consecutive finite rows j whose current I[j] is below -1e-5 A
schema_and_target.target: cycle discharge capacity divided by the median capacity of the first five structurally eligible cycles

prediction_contract.charge_definition: first contiguous positive-current block within cycle that covers the fixed 600-second feature window

confirmatory_estimand.primary_metric: cell-equal mean of within-cell MAE(PCHP)-MAE(protected baseline)

decision_gates.execution: at least 36 eligible physical cells; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE
decision_gates.mean_effect: cell-equal mean PCHP-minus-baseline MAE is below zero
decision_gates.win_fraction: at least two thirds of non-tied physical cells improve
decision_gates.uncertainty: upper endpoint of the 95% cell bootstrap interval is below zero
decision_gates.harm_contract: maximum pointwise displacement, maximum observed absolute-loss regret, and maximum cell-macro harm are each at most 0.01 plus 1e-12
decision_gates.decision: RETAIN only if execution and all four scientific gates pass; otherwise REJECT

stop_rule: After this freeze, do not change the 47-cell roster, schema, time conversion, capacity recovery rule, source model, window, anchor, alphas, harm budget, aggregation, uncertainty unit, or gates in response to confirmation outcomes. Mechanical implementation defects must be recorded and cannot alter the scientific rules.
